blocks.text: The docstring places this router in the Master Guide V2 timeline (patch 8, Build tab Code sub-tab) and explains why it is a separate file from workspace_data.py. The imports pull in FastAPI, Pydantic, the eo/workspace_code_files delegate, and the shared auth/workspace dependencies. _require_workspace is defined locally: it fetches the workspace, checks ownership, and raises 404 if either check fails.
blocks.title: Module docstring, imports and workspace guard

blocks.text: CodeFileWriteRequest carries content, language, and an optional base_version used for optimistic concurrency. MovePathRequest aliases the 'from' field because 'from' is a Python keyword; the alias makes the JSON wire shape {from, to} without renaming the Python attribute.
blocks.title: Request body models

blocks.text: list_code_files returns file metadata only (no content) for all code files in the workspace. list_code_findings returns every stored finding — lint, type errors, and similar — ordered by file then line. Both are GET routes and require only read-level workspace ownership.
blocks.title: Listing routes: files and findings

blocks.text: get_code_file_history and restore_code_file are registered here, before the generic /{file_path:path} GET, because FastAPI matches routes in declaration order and {file_path:path} would otherwise consume the /history and /restore segments. get_code_file_history returns past versions most-recent-first, excluding the live version. restore_code_file writes a new version without touching the history chain.
blocks.title: History and restore, registered before the greedy GET route

blocks.text: put_code_file creates or updates a file. When req.base_version is provided, the underlying eo call checks for a version conflict and raises VersionConflictError, which is caught here and returned as 409 with the current file body so the caller can merge. ValueError (e.g. invalid path) is returned as 400.
blocks.title: File write with optional optimistic concurrency

blocks.text: delete_code_file matches file_path as an exact file or, if no exact match, as a folder prefix to delete an entire subtree; it is idempotent — an empty deleted_paths list is a valid success response. move_code_path renames or moves a file or subtree in one transaction and carries history to the new path; it refuses to clobber an existing destination.
blocks.title: Delete and move: prefix-aware operations

blocks.text: create_code_folder writes a .gitkeep placeholder because the database has no folder concept; without a file inside, an empty folder would be invisible. download_code_zip returns a StreamingResponse that builds the ZIP in memory via workspace_code_files.build_zip_archive(), so no temporary files are written to disk.
blocks.title: Folder creation and ZIP download

how_it_works: Every route starts with _require_workspace(ws_id, owner_id) which 404s if the workspace does not belong to the caller.
Routes then delegate to eo/workspace_code_files functions.
History and restore routes are registered before the generic /{file_path:path} GET/PUT routes because FastAPI matches routes in registration order and {file_path:path} is greedy.
VersionConflictError is caught and returned as 409 with the current file body; ValueError is caught and returned as 400.
delete_code_file is idempotent: an empty deleted_paths list does not produce a 404.
download_code_zip returns a StreamingResponse with application/zip content type.
purpose: Exposes the Build tab's Code sub-tab API. Delegates all data access to eo/workspace_code_files.py and enforces workspace ownership via a local _require_workspace guard on every route.
summary: FastAPI router for workspace code-file CRUD: list, get, create/update, delete, move, folder creation and ZIP download under /api/workspaces/{ws_id}/code/.
